desc: The EOTech line of Vudu rifle scopes is where durability, precision and versatility meet. Our rifle scopes are engineered and constructed to meet the most rugged demands of the serious precision shooter. Starting from a solid piece of aircraft-grade aluminum and finished with the highest quality AR-coated (HD) glass and surgically precise turret systems, the Vudu line of rifle scopes lets you deliver that critical shot when it matters most.
